pick.headline: Khomeyni proclaims the Islamic Republic of Iran
pick.fbis: The Middle East & North Africa Daily Report for April 1979 carried, under its Iran heading, reportage on the referendum on an Islamic Republic: a ministry statement on balloting, extra ballot supplies, a Khomeyni statement after voting, and balloting in Kordestan.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Middle East & N. Africa, Vol. V No. 064 - 084, April 1979
